source.title: Personality and marital surplus

research.quote: The effects of individual personality traits on the marriage probabilities of men and women are quite distinct, though there are two common elements in all specifications—openness to experience decreases marriage for both men and women, while conscientiousness increases the probability of marriage.
research.notes: Value is the average marginal effect of conscientiousness for men from Table 3 column 2 (0.055, SE 0.013), as a probability change (0.055 = 5.5 points) per SD; women 0.031 (SE 0.010). Germany, cohorts born 1945-1970.
